name: Student-visa cover for mixed DPRK worker deployments including IT workers

attribution.legal_posture: This is an MSMT-reported visa-sponsorship and deployment assessment; Russian immigration status and sponsored-person number, conduct, and present status require public adjudication or current official records.

caveats: This source-bounded report covers its cited context; Russian enforcement, host-company knowledge, completed implementation, current operating status, nationality, and criminal liability fall outside its findings.
General construction, industrial, educational, or other overseas labor is excluded unless the source explicitly states an IT-worker nexus.
The mixed-worker total spans multiple roles; an IT-worker total requires role-specific counting.
The visa-sponsorship claim is a reported immigration assertion; it is not a public Russian immigration adjudication, and the sponsored IT-worker count requires separate evidence.
This is aggregate or contract-level context; profiles for listed entity types require person- or case-specific sources.

infrastructure.statement: MSMT reports plans for DPRK workers to enter Russia on student visas under educational cover and says a sponsoring institution supported student visas for hundreds of DPRK workers in 2024 across multiple fields, explicitly including IT workers. The public passage does not quantify the IT-worker subset.
infrastructure.evidence_class: official multilateral report based on participating-state information
infrastructure.attribution_boundary: This is an MSMT-reported visa-sponsorship and deployment assessment, not a public Russian immigration adjudication or proof of the number, conduct, or present status of any sponsored person.
